##### Project general facts

Vestoria Bay by Ahmadyar Developments is a sculptural residential building inspired by the calm beauty of the desert and the soothing rhythm of the sea. Wave-like balconies, clean lines and soft natural textures define an architecture that echoes the coastline. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, townhouses and penthouses, with selected homes featuring private pools and jacuzzis, panoramic balconies and garden views. A curved, softly lit lobby creates a calm sense of arrival.

The Vestoria Bay Club spreads across three levels of shared amenities. The family zone features a family and kids' pool, a barbecue and dining area, an indoor gym, a kids' play zone and an amphitheatre. The garden deck adds an outdoor cinema, sky gardens and a sunset lounge, while the rooftop youth terrace offers an infinity pool with jacuzzi, a signature bar counter, an exclusive rooftop lounge, a yoga and aerobics area and private changing rooms.

Interiors combine soft curves, natural textures and calming coastal light. Residences feature spacious living areas, open kitchens and laundry areas, with smart home automation in the larger homes. Two- and three-bedroom apartments, townhouses and penthouses include a maid's room and storage space. Homes are delivered fully furnished, with fitted kitchen appliances in selected layouts, allowing residents to move in and enjoy coastal living from day one.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a coastal master community by Nakheel on the Deira waterfront, combining an extensive public beachfront, marinas, golf courses, a community park and a wide choice of resorts and hotels. The islands offer a relaxed, resort-style environment with sunset views across the water, while the community mall and waterfront dining keep everyday needs close at hand.

The Infinity Bridge links the islands to the mainland, placing Al Mamzar Beach, Dubai Hospital, Deira City Centre and the Museum of Illusions a short drive away. Dubai International Airport is also within easy reach, and the wider road network connects residents with Dubai Maritime City, the cruise terminal and the rest of the city.

Dubai Islands is a freehold destination that appeals to end users seeking beachfront living close to the city and to investors focused on premium rental demand. Its resort-style setting, marinas and proximity to the airport support both long-term and holiday rentals. As one of Dubai's key coastal master plans, the community offers strong potential for long-term value.
